design_quote: Direct comparisons between the mean score change from the baseline of each treatment group to the follow-up period of interest were quantified through calculation of a mean difference and 95% confidence interval (CI).
k_quote: We included 10 studies involving 776 patients and 819 hands.
reason: Labelled an NMA of RCTs, but the methods report random-effects direct pairwise comparisons (MD with CI), which counts as pairwise; 10 RCTs included.
